description: MMS gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 tests of problems/heat_1d_varcoeff_zero_flux.esm (model Heat, test mms_varcoeff_zero_flux_decay) at the problem's default resolution (N=64) through each binding's official simulation pathway. Exercises the conservative finite-volume variable-coefficient Laplacian rule varcoeff_laplacian_zero_flux_bc lowering the compound D(k*D(u,x),x). The assertions and their tolerances live in the problem file itself; this manifest only routes the runners.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

blocked_upstream_bindings.rust: Rust hangs at every tolerance tried (loosest reltol 1e-6; all three solvers Erk/Bdf/Sdirk wedge). earthsci-ast-rs's diffsol integrator has no dtmin/max-step fail-fast guard, so on this stiff / non-smooth-min-max / large-AST RHS it drives dt->0 without terminating instead of erroring. Julia (Tsit5) and Python (LSODA) solve it. Remove once the Rust solver gains a step guard.
